title: Bound-matrix verification component
responsibilities: Execute the bound-matrix verification of every declared DecodeLimits member.
Prove accept at the bound and fail-closed over it, including every limit below 1.
state_ownership: none; the component holds no state and owns no runtime resource
concurrency: offline-single-threaded; one test process, no thread, no mutable shared state
errors: GoogleTest assertion failure on an accepted breach or a returned value
deployment: repository-local test process; no runtime deployment and no activation
rationale: The declared bounded-overflow contract is exercised with small bounded vectors and adjusted caps; no production numeric value is fixed.
